description: GroMoPo, the Groundwater Model Portal, is a published inventory of regional to global groundwater models with a Streamlit search application. Its GitHub repository contains tabular collected-model data and the application code for exploring the entries. Users can search model properties, geography and sources, then follow the listed model references for further assessment. The data are a model registry, not groundwater observations or a runnable flow simulator. Geographic coverage is international and depends on the models submitted to the portal. The repository states free CC0-1.0 terms and gives instructions for running the app locally. A limitation is that a listed model's source, licence and current availability need verification at its own provider before reuse; the hosted Streamlit site could not be independently opened in this review. GroMoPo can guide selection of groundwater models for water-supply or aquifer simulations. The related catalogue Costa Rica monitoring network is a separate observation source. No portal dataset or model archive was downloaded.
name: GroMoPo groundwater-model inventory
notes: G7 G7-1558. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
